 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Tari Eason came off the bench and scored a season-high 25 points as the Houston Rockets cruised past the Washington Wizards on Sunday.
 But when asked what helped him on the night, the forward gave an answer that caught the reporter off guard and quickly became a talking point among NBA fans.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Fans React to Tari Eason's Brutally Honest Answer After 25-Point Night
 Eason needed just 30 minutes to put up 25 points in Houston's 147-119 win. He shot 10-for-14 from the field, knocked down three of his five attempts from beyond the arc and added 7 rebounds.
 However, his postgame response also grabbed a lot of attention. Asked what allowed him to produce his best scoring performance of the season, Eason simply replied, "(expletive), the Wizards, for real, it was them."
 The reporter appeared surprised and paused for a few seconds before moving on to the next question. Fans were just as stunned by the blunt response.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Clippers fan Jamal Cristopher wrote , "This is a level of disrespect that u rarely see."
 One fan added , "Diabolical to say that, even tho its true."
 Barstool Sports' Max Dolente reacted with "This can't be real," and yet another fan wrote , "No respect LMAO."
 The comment also brought up two previous moments involving Washington. One fan clubbed three events and joked that they were enough to "disband" the franchise.
 "Including this video with the Trae Young contract and the Bam 83 yeah disband the Wizards franchise," they wrote .
 The Bam Adebayo reference goes back to March, when the Miami Heat center scored 83 points against Washington in a 150-129 win. It was the second-highest individual scoring total in NBA history, behind Wilt Chamberlain's 100.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The reaction comes as the Wizards are on a spree of poor results. The Rockets handed the Wizards their seventh consecutive defeat, dropping them to 4-10 for the season.
 Houston scored 147 points after shooting 57.8% from the field. This was the second time this season the Wizards had conceded at least 140 points in a defeat. They previously lost 144-140 to the Detroit Pistons on November 12. Washington also gave up 139 points in a loss to the Atlanta Hawks.
 The fan's reference to Trae Young's contract was particularly pointed after the guard was held scoreless against Houston. Young went 0-for-5 from the field, recording the first scoreless game of his 512-game NBA career.
 That comes just months after Washington committed to him with a four-year, approximately $212 million contract.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement MORE: 'Who Did We Draft?' — Suns Commentators Lament Phoenix Passing on Luka Dončić in 2018 NBA Draft Amid Lakers Star's 43-Point Showcase 
 For Eason, the night was a major personal achievement. He entered the game averaging 9.7 points, making his 25-point performance a significant jump from his usual production. The Rockets improved to 11-3 with their fourth straight win.
 Washington's struggles, meanwhile, have stretched well beyond this season. The Wizards finished 18-64 in 2024-25 and 17-65 in 2025-26, missing the playoffs in both campaigns. They have not won a playoff series since 2017, and their continued struggles have left fans questioning the franchise's direction.
 With another losing start and heavy defeats piling up, Eason's blunt response has only added to the growing frustration surrounding Washington.
